description: Create a new editable draft in the user's resume builder, with the text the user gives saved as its summary section (up to 2,000 characters). It does not split text into experience, education or skills, and it creates no PDF: the user completes the sections in the builder and downloads the PDF there. Templates: classic (default), modern or minimal. The draft is private; set make_public to true only when the user explicitly asks to share it, which publishes a link anyone can open. It adds a new draft and changes no existing resume. Requires a paid plan (Hired in 30+). Do not use it to rewrite or tailor a resume; use getmattered_optimize_resume. Next: the user opens the builder link to finish the draft.

make_public.description: Publish a public share link to the draft. Anyone with the link sees it INCLUDING its contact details. Defaults to false (private). Only set true when the user explicitly asks to share it.

summary_text.description: The text to save as the draft's summary section, 50 to 2,000 characters, as the user wrote or approved it.

template.description: Resume template style: classic (default), modern or minimal.

name: getmattered_create_resume_draft

documentId.description: The resume document whose PDF the link opens, when no draft was created.

publicUrl.description: The public share link. Null unless sharing was asked for and succeeded.

resumeBuildId.description: The new resume-builder draft. Null from getmattered_get_resume_pdf_link and getmattered_share_resume_pdf, which create no draft.

template.description: The draft's template. Null when no draft was created.

url.description: The private link: the builder draft, or the documents page of the resume on file. It needs the user's sign-in.

title: Create Resume Builder Draft
